nodes.label: main.go
nodes.description: The entry point of the application. Initializes the app, handles command line arguments, and delegates to the appropriate logic based on user input.

nodes.label: weather.go
nodes.description: Retrieves weather data for a given city from the OpenWeatherMap API. Handles network requests, error parsing, and data validation.

nodes.label: display.go
nodes.description: Displays the weather data to the user. Handles formatting and rendering the data to the console or a simple GUI.
